const (
	Invalid = Aggregator(iota)
	Avg
	Sum
	Min
	Max
	Range
	Count
	First
	Last
	StdP
	StdS
	VarP
	VarS
	Twa
	CountNaN
	CountAll
)

func ( Aggregator) () string {
	switch  {
	case Invalid:
		return ""
	case Avg:
		return "AVG"
	case Sum:
		return "SUM"
	case Min:
		return "MIN"
	case Max:
		return "MAX"
	case Range:
		return "RANGE"
	case Count:
		return "COUNT"
	case First:
		return "FIRST"
	case Last:
		return "LAST"
	case StdP:
		return "STD.P"
	case StdS:
		return "STD.S"
	case VarP:
		return "VAR.P"
	case VarS:
		return "VAR.S"
	case Twa:
		return "TWA"
	case CountNaN:
		return "COUNTNAN"
	case CountAll:
		return "COUNTALL"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
